text:
Ava (partnerships): Heads up — partners flagged that the SDK response-envelope change in v3 will break some marketplace integrations. Need a short orchestration checklist and timing.
Marco (platform): Agreed. We should map impacted partners + list of mitigations (shim, feature flag, docs). quick ask: do we have a proposed timeline?
Rina (eng): Tentative plan: announce deprecation in two weeks, enable opt-in shim for 30 days, then soft-enforce in 60, hard-enforce in 90. Canary for top partners at +45 days.
Sam (marketplace): Marketplace release windows mean we need comms 10 business days before any enforcement. Partners on managed listings require a 30-day notice at minimum.
Priya (partner-eng): For hardware SI partners, they push SDKs through internal CI — they'll need the shim and a migration guide with code snippets. I can draft examples.
Ava (partnerships): Good. Can we add telemetry + a compatibility metric in Console so we can track who is still on old envelope?
Marco (platform): Yes — we can add a header-based signal: `x-rw-sdk-envelope-version: 2` on legacy. Then dashboard shows percentage. I'll file a quick task.
Rina (eng): Shim approach: accept both envelopes server-side and emit a deprecation warning header for legacy. Example: ```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
x-rw-deprecation: envelope-v2; will-remove=2026-06-01
```
Ava (partnerships): Love the example. For partner comms: sequence = embargoed partner PSA -> public deprecation blog -> SDK release with shim -> marketplace compatibility window -> hard-enforce.
Sam (marketplace): Can we align the public blog date with the next marketplace release window (May 4)? If not, marketplace listing teams need an exception.
Priya (partner-eng): I'll audit partner contracts for required notice windows; flagging 3 partners (AlphaSI, CloudHub, DataWorks) who need legal review.
Marco (platform): OpsBot, please create a tracking doc and set reminders: announce, shim release, canary, public blog, hard-enforce.
OpsBot: Created doc: https://intranet.redwood/sdks/dep-1765554321 and set reminders for 2026-04-15, 2026-04-30, 2026-05-15, 2026-06-01.
Ava (partnerships): Action items: Priya to send contract flags by EOD tomorrow, Rina to draft shim PR by end of week, Marco to add telemetry tile, Sam to lock marketplace window. I’ll start partner embargo list.
Rina (eng): Noted — PR will include migration snippet: ````js
// v2 -> v3 envelope migration
const res = await client.generate(payload);
const body = res.envelope ?? res.data;
````
Sam (marketplace): Confirmed — I'll block May 4 window for the blog and provide publishing checklist.
Priya (partner-eng): I'll ping legal and loop back.
Ava (partnerships): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: We’ll reconvene after PR + doc ready for a short tabletop with 3 partners.
Marco (platform): Scheduling tabletop for 2026-04-20 16:00 PT.
Ava (partnerships): Perfect. End of thread.
